action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that tmpreaper incorrectly handled certain mount
operations, leading to a race condition. A local attacker could possibly
use this issue to create arbitrary files, leading to privilege escalation.
isummary: tmpreaper could be made to run programs as an administrator.

tmpreaper.description: cleans up files in directories based on their age

title: tmpreaper vulnerability
